description_en: Increases the bandwidth of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用UpgradeSmartAccessGateway接口升高智能接入网关实例的带宽。
kebab_example: aliyun smartag upgrade-smart-access-gateway --smart-ag-id sag-d3m51apgw4po000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-pay true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeSmartAccessGateway

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the SAG instance belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the SAG instance.

Value range for an SAG-100WM device: 2 to 50. Unit: Mbit/s
Value range for an SAG-1000 device: 10 to 500. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关的带宽。 

如果网关设备规格为sag-100wm，带宽取值：2~50Mbps 。
          
如果网关设备规格为sag-1000，带宽取值：10~500Mbps
parameters.name: band_width_spec

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to automatically pay the bill for a subscription instance.

Valid values: true | false. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否是自动支付预付费实例的账单。取值：

true：是。

false：否
parameters.name: auto_pay
